in_english.name: Cordie
in_english.meaning: Servant of God, mistress of the church, daughter of the Savior
in_english.long_meaning: Cordie is a name that refers to the daughter of God as a perfect servant. It represents the love and submission to God. This name is a reference to the perfect submission and love that a person has for God. The etymology of Cordie comes from the Hebrew word קורד (qord), which means cord or string. In Christian tradition, Cordie is a name that symbolizes the connection between God and humanity, much like a cord or string connects two objects. It is a name that represents the bond of love and submission between God and humanity.
